exposure: Prophylactic measures for vertical HIV transmission
Timing of elective caesarean section for HIV-positive women with high viral loads
AZT dosage and timing before delivery
outcome: Knowledge of health professionals regarding prophylactic measures for vertical HIV transmission
cohort: 25 health professionals caring for pregnant HIV-positive women in a public hospital in the State of Goias, Brazil.
finding: The majority of health professionals surveyed demonstrated inadequate knowledge regarding key prophylactic measures for vertical HIV transmission.
mod_finding: 80% of professionals were unaware of the appropriate gestational age for elective caesarean section when viral load is greater than 1000 copies/ml.
